title: Auth Middleware Compiler
description: Formal compiler for authentication middleware: token verification, expiry, refresh, rate limiting, and secret hygiene. Foundational — no upstream dependencies.

pipeline.title: Parse Intent
pipeline.description: Extract auth spec: strategy (JWT/session/API key), token shape, expiry policy, refresh policy, rate limits

pipeline.title: Scaffold
pipeline.description: Generate middleware.ts, token.ts, errors.ts, and types.ts stubs

pipeline.title: Implement
pipeline.description: Full auth implementation: verify token, check expiry, handle refresh, enforce rate limits

pipeline.title: Test
pipeline.description: Unit tests: valid token, expired token, malformed token, missing token, refresh flow, rate limit hit

pipeline.title: Verify
pipeline.description: Security contract verification: no secrets leaked, timing-safe comparisons, proper error messages

pipeline.title: Attest
pipeline.description: Produce signed auth-artifact.json for downstream compilers (api-route cross-check)

gates.title: Spec Valid
gates.description: auth-spec.json exists with required fields: strategy, tokenShape, expiry, refresh

gates.title: Exports Valid
gates.description: middleware.ts exports requireAuth, optionalAuth. token.ts exports signToken, verifyToken.

gates.title: No Hardcoded Secrets
gates.description: No JWT secrets, API keys, or passwords hardcoded in source — must use process.env or secret broker

gates.title: Expiry Checked
gates.description: Token verification explicitly checks expiry — no jwt.decode() without verify(), no ignoring exp claim

gates.title: No TODOs
gates.description: No TODO/FIXME/HACK/PLACEHOLDER in auth implementation files

gates.title: Typed Auth Errors
gates.description: Auth errors use typed classes (AuthError, TokenExpiredError, InvalidTokenError) — not generic Error

gates.title: Tests Pass
gates.description: All auth unit tests pass: valid/expired/malformed/missing token, refresh, rate limit

gates.title: Test Coverage
gates.description: ≥85% line coverage for middleware.ts and token.ts (higher bar than default — auth is critical path)

gates.title: Timing-Safe Comparisons
gates.description: API key or secret comparisons use crypto.timingSafeEqual — never === or string comparison

gates.title: No Secret Leak
gates.description: Error messages and logs never include token values, secrets, or raw credentials

gates.title: Auth Contract
gates.description: Middleware matches auth.contract.json: requireAuth signature, error envelope shape, header extraction

contracts.description: Structural and security requirements for all compiled auth middleware

error_codes.AM004: Token expiry not checked during verification
error_codes.AM006: Generic Error used instead of typed AuthError
error_codes.AM009: String comparison used instead of timingSafeEqual
error_codes.AM010: Token or secret value exposed in error message or log
